# Prime Auditors

> Licensed Tanzanian CPA firm (NBAA PF510) based in Tanga, offering auditing, tax advisory, bookkeeping, business registration, and foreign investor consulting.

## Pages

- [Home](/en): Overview of Prime Auditors services and certifications.
- [Services](/en/services): Audit, tax, bookkeeping, payroll, and advisory services.
- [About Us](/en/about): Firm history, leadership, and core values.
- [Foreign Investors](/en/foreign-investors): Specialized services for foreign investors entering Tanzania.
- [News](/en/news): Insights on Tanzanian audit, tax, and regulatory updates.
- [Join Us](/en/join): Careers and recruitment.
